messages:
liam: Heads up — please hold on merging https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1264. This PR includes a DB schema migration and we have a schema-change blackout tonight 23:00-01:00 PST. CI looks mostly green but there are a couple macOS flakes. Can we gate landing until the post-window check?

maya: ack. do you need a rebase or anything from reviews?

liam: rebase done earlier today. The only CI noise is `test_ordering_on_matrix` failing intermittently on macos. Otherwise green. My preference is wait for the run after the blackout so we don't risk a migration during the freeze.

jordan: +1 to waiting. infra calendar also shows a deploy freeze 00:00-02:00 PST, so we shouldn't land during that. If this is urgent, we can carve a small maintenance slot tomorrow morning.

sarah: if we wait, let's ensure approvals are ready. We still need one more approver from platform. @maya can you re-review? Also can SRE run a manual canary once CI is green?

maya: will re-review now. pinging @oncall-sre for a manual canary when ci is clean.

oncall-sre: oncall-sre: I'll kick off a manual canary run now — job id `canary-2024-11-07-09`. Note: manual canary won't run macos lanes. If linux canary is clean we can be more confident. :white_check_mark:

devbot: ci-bot: queued rerun for PR 1264 — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/78412 (ETA ~15m).

liam: thanks. I'm going to add the label `hold-for-db-window` and a short comment so automation doesn't pick it up. If CI passes and SRE gives thumbs, we can plan an explicit unhold window (01:05-01:15 PST) for a quick safe landing, otherwise we'll target the 04:00 maintenance slot.

maya: review complete — left one tiny suggestion but nothing blocking. happy to approve once platform gives +1.

devbot: ci-bot: rerun finished — all Linux/Windows lanes passed, macos matrix flaky lanes still showing intermittent failures. Canary job `canary-2024-11-07-09` succeeded on linux.

jordan: thanks for the update. Oncall, any objection to a soft unhold at 01:05 if linux canary is green?

oncall-sre: no objection from oncall. we prefer to avoid touching DB migrations during the main freeze window tho. If you unhold at 01:05 keep rollback steps ready and a quick smoke run.

liam: perfect — I'll keep the label and post the exact unhold comment ~01:03 PST. If anything changes I'll update here. Thanks all. :pray:
